mapping_system.purpose: This file IS the scaffolding for the data-lab files mapping system. The toolkit will not walk the original vAUTOMATION tree — it will read this map.
how_it_works: 1. data-lab/ is empty (only .gitkeep) — the real corpus lives elsewhere, but this map is the expected landing spot for the 1st subset.

2. toolkit/ingest/t0_survey.py is taught to read FILES-MAP.json when corpus_root is data-lab and data-lab is empty: it will synthesize ledger rows from this map (size, type, path) without needing the actual files.
3. toolkit/ingest/t1_discovery.py will use the map's by-type and by-location to seed clusters (e.g., 'vAUTOMATION/.archive' → cluster, 'HARVES' → cluster).

4. When the full list arrives (you said this is ONE SUBSET), this file will be appended — never overwritten — to grow the universe. The Template Universe Engine (toolkit/docs/plans/template-universe-engine/) will auto-update the 36-table map to include the new landing spots.

5. The portable's VPLANNER.bat and manifest.yaml will remain self-sufficient: if data-lab is empty, the pipeline still runs (0 files → 0 fragments → 0 conflicts → docpack/program scaffolds), but the map gives it a *knowable* expected corpus to verify against.
